mentions.name: Pet Insurance Claims Automation Service
mentions.description: This service automates claims processing for a pet insurance company. Though it is back-office facing, it speeds up customer reimbursements and shortens the feedback loop when additional documentation is needed from policyholders.
mentions.problem: Claims handling was slow, delaying reimbursements and dragging out the back-and-forth when more documentation was required from customers.
mentions.audience: Back-office staff at a pet insurance company; end-user customers also benefit through faster reimbursements.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a claims automation service for a pet insurance company I work for. Interesting because its backoffice facing but still helps our end users to get their reimbursements faster and makes the feedback loop when we need more documentation from them shorter.

evidence.value: Working on a claims automation service for a pet insurance company I work for. Interesting because its backoffice facing but still helps our end users to get their reimbursements faster and makes the feedback loop when we need more documentation from them shorter.
